[P2] Identify the required design note for this notification feature

`CONTRIBUTING.md` rule 3 requires a maintainer-agreed design note for new features. This adds notification behavior, but the description only explains the implementation and upstream pin; it does not identify the required problem, cause, alternatives, chosen approach, and removals. The approach therefore lacks the required review basis. Return to the design phase under rules 8 and 9 and provide the agreed note, or identify the upstream note and approval if they cover this adoption.
